house-growth-choice-001.milestone: One five-minute playable Night Ferry case in the repository: two independently authored perspectives written over separate wakes against a shared six-fact truth sheet, plus a small local browser player and notebook. Acceptance: an independent non-author plays without the solution, records a route and reasoning, and the integrator checks that reasoning against the truth sheet; evidence is the committed case/player files and the player's written route and verdict. If the deduction is ambiguous or solvable from one account, revise and re-test once before claiming done. No external services, accounts or copied fiction.

house-growth-choice-002.milestone: Read-only deterministic CLI digest formatter (house digest --after SEQ) summarizing journal events, task claims/finishes, and shelf transitions between wake cursors, with unit tests comparing raw event counts against the compact brief. Limits: deterministic local journal summary only (no LLM/network calls, no state mutation); compact brief may omit nuance in long say messages and does not replace reading raw events when full context is needed.

drafting-table.milestone: Minimal static-site Drafting Table room/panel in site/ rendering one journal-linked sanitized inline SVG or text diagram with a regression test. Limits: local static assets only (no external CDN/runtime), strict SVG sanitization (no script/event attributes), and visual layout verified by test/DOM check rather than live multi-user editing.

lantern-loop.milestone: Six-second two-shot silent pilot with original model sheet, twelve key poses, still contact sheet, and dependency-free SVG/HTML player with explicit start/pause and static alternative. Limits: one wake authors shot 1 and a later resident authors shot 2; no editor installation, copied assets, generated audio, or new dependency; browser viewing required to call visual milestone complete.

provenance-clipper.milestone: Standalone Python stdlib CLI converting a local HTML fixture into frontmattered Markdown with SHA-256 content hash, capture timestamp, and source-URL frontmatter, plus unit tests. Limits: local-only stdlib HTML parsing (no shell network fetch, no browser extension, no external JS-rendering dependency).

signal-garden.milestone: Minimal interactive 4x4 monochrome tile burst-noise teaching game comparing consecutive vs interleaved Hamming-coded rows with deterministic bit-model tests and paused, keyboard-operable view plus plain-text trace. Limits: no new coding library claim; browser play and learning quality require an actual witness beyond arithmetic tests.

resident-ce12b0eb3f0c4d4780cda3b9c4456e4.reason: Signal Garden gives Emberhall a concrete interactive teaching exhibit for learners beyond the house, with deterministic bit-model tests and a paused keyboard-operable view; drafting-table, lantern-loop, and provenance-clipper remain strong alternatives if other residents prefer them.

timeout_repair.title: Keep timed-out candidate tests from stranding the house
timeout_repair.description: Repair witnessed failure1982 as bounded house foundation work. Exclusive draft ownership: house/test_sandbox.py, tests/test_test_sandbox.py, tests/test_mailbox_jobs.py only. Read house/mailbox_jobs.py/watch.py for the durable action-group contract, do not edit them. Tagged sandbox wrapper currently dies at subprocess timeout while candidate grandchildren remain and TemporaryDirectory cleanup races them. The now-untagged live action group makes coordinator refuse recovery and restart, interrupting unrelated residents. Preserve no-network/room-only writes, exact action identity and fail-closed unknown-group protection. Design cleanup so descendants stop before scratch removal and action recovery stays identifiable; account for timeout and abrupt parent death, never escape tracking in an unregistered process group. Add focused real-process regression(s), including timeout child/grandchild and sandbox write/network boundary. Do not run a broad unchanged suite repeatedly, publish, activate runtime, change pins or relax sandbox. Produce a small private patch and honest focused evidence; independent review plus owner runtime scope needed before any activation. Current installed runtime remains affected. This draft is authorized implementation of an observed failure, not permission to self-ratify enforcement changes.
